main_body: marble column with capital, shaft, and base
top_band: light grey/white horizontal surface of the column capital across rows 9-12, with a bright white front-edge highlight at row 12
evidence: Reading down the center column: row 8 is the top outline, rows 9-12 form a 4-row light-grey top surface of the capital ending in a bright white front-edge highlight on row 12. Rows 13-14 are the shaded front face of the capital, rows 15-16 show the eave shadow under the capital overhanging the shaft, rows 17-39 are the vertical shaft, and rows 40-47 form the base with its own top shelf (rows 41-44) and front face (rows 45-46).

style.evidence: The marble column uses 6 distinct grey/cool-grey value steps across the capital, shaft cylinder shading, and base, with dark grey/slate material outlines rather than pure black. The cylindrical gradient and bevel highlights are cleanly rendered without large flat fills, though as a smooth stone column it has slightly less surface speckle than the multi-material reference props.
